Q: is it possible to draw a line with a "gap" using lightweight-charts? A:

Maybe a bit late, but as of now it's possible by settings colors of individual points to 'transparent'. One might think that it changes the color of point itself, but it changes the color of line from this point rightwards till the next one as well.

https://tradingview.github.io/lightweight-charts/docs/api/interfaces/CustomData#color

For you example it would be:

const arr = [
{ time: "2019-04-11", value: 80.01 },
{ time: "2019-04-12", value: 96.63 },
{ time: "2019-04-13", value: 76.64 },
{ time: "2019-04-14", value: 81.89 },
{ time: "2019-04-15", value: 74.43 },
{ time: "2019-04-16", value: 80.01 },
{ time: "2019-04-17", value: 96.63 },
{ time: "2019-04-18", value: 76.64 },
{ time: "2019-04-19", value: 81.89 },
{ time: "2019-04-20", value: 74.43, color: 'transparent' }, //this point will look a bit ugly
{ time: "2019-04-21", value: NaN, color: 'transparent' },
{ time: "2019-04-22", value: NaN, color: 'transparent' },
{ time: "2019-04-23", value: NaN, color: 'transparent' },
{ time: "2019-04-24", value: 174.43 }

Instead of nans, whitespacedata can be used, but if you remove them, days will be omitted.

Q: Symfony2 : Failed to start the session because headers have already been sent A:

This line contained a print_r statement. After I commented it out, the error disappeared.

Q: OpenCV Stereo Matching/Calibration A:

I found similar problems when using OpenCV (v.2.4.6) 3D reconstruction function. Some people, like Martin Peris, have implemented again by themselves. http://blog.martinperis.com/2012/01/3d-reconstruction-with-opencv-and-point.html

Sadly, sometimes I have found problems in both implementations with my data. So, I supposed my problem in these cases is due to a poor extrinsic camera parameter description. Perhaps, it is your case too. :-?

PS. In order to get rid of the background you'll need segment it. Or, at least, check depth values bigger than a threshold once the reconstruction works. handleMissingValues flag only eliminates points at "infinity" PS2. Please, tell us if you solve this problem. I think it is valuable for all comunity. Thnx
